-- proof tint for stairs (restore with untint.lua): stone red, riser green, joint blue; also any other K_Stairs* parts magenta
local function t(p,c) if p:GetAttribute("T27o")==nil then p:SetAttribute("T27o",p.Color) end p.Color=c end
local P25=workspace.Plaza.Pass25
t(P25.Stairs25_stone,Color3.new(1,0,0)) t(P25.Stairs25_riser,Color3.new(0,1,0)) t(P25.Stairs25_joint,Color3.new(0,0,1))
local n,o=0,{}
for _,d in ipairs(workspace.Plaza:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency<1 and d.Name:find("Stair") and not d:IsDescendantOf(P25) then t(d,Color3.new(1,0,1)) n+=1 table.insert(o,d:GetFullName()) end end
return n.." "..table.concat(o,", ")
